critique: The render strongly matches the Large Snow 3D look in sprite detail, black background, 3D-facing brightness variation, and prominent individual flakes. Frame t1 has an appropriately open, large-flake-led composition. By t4, however, too many additional flakes remain visible, producing a noticeably busier central/lower field and several distracting cropped edge flakes. The temporal population increase still departs from the preset's cleaner, more spacious thumbnail silhouette.

suggestions.why: Reduce the emission rate so the later frame does not accumulate into a crowded field of small and edge-cropped flakes, while retaining a few clearly readable large snowflake sprites.
